title: Password reset required after account lockout
description: User entered incorrect password multiple times and account is now locked.
knowledge_base: Verify user identity before resetting password.
Check whether account lockout policy triggered automatically.
Reset password and confirm MFA if enabled.

Ping printer IP address.
Verify printer queue on print server.

Confirm system sound is not muted.
Test speakers in Windows sound settings.
Reconnect headset and restart Teams.

Review attachment size limits.
Test sending a simple email without attachment.
Recreate Outlook profile if issue persists.

title: Monitor flickering on docking station

Test with another port or cable.
Update dock firmware and graphics driver.
Verify refresh rate settings.

title: Shared folder access denied
description: User receives access denied error when opening department shared folder.

Check NTFS and share permissions.
Test access with another affected user.
Document exact folder path and error message.

Disconnect and remap drive.

title: New employee requires account creation
